description: At 38.2378N 140.9248E; used as a maintenance training airframe by the Northeastern Army field maintenance unit and marked NEAFM; moved indoors for the August 2023 anniversary event
Near the main gate at 38.2379N 140.9246E from 2007 to 2018 then moved inside the camp; still present at the August 2023 anniversary event
Field maintenance unit instructional airframe used heavily for PR around Sendai; trucked to Camp Sendai for display on 28 Sep 2022 and shown at the Sendai PTA festival in Nov 2023
Believed to be a Northeastern Army maintenance training airframe inside a hangar; inferred from a 2024 PR photograph
